# Code of conduct

OpenShaker is a small, friendly project for people who like feeling their games. Everyone is welcome,
whatever their experience, rig or background.

## In short

- **Be kind and patient.** Many people here are new to haptics, audio or GitHub.
- **Be constructive.** Describe problems clearly and assume good intent.
- **Respect people's time and privacy.** Don't post other people's personal information, and check
  logs for your own before attaching them.
- **No harassment**, insults, discrimination or unwanted personal attention - in issues, discussions,
  pull requests or anywhere else connected with the project.

## Enforcement

The maintainer may edit, hide or remove comments, issues or contributions that break this code, and may
block people who repeatedly or seriously do. To report a problem privately, use
[a private security advisory](https://github.com/baddo-baddo/OpenShaker/security/advisories/new) and
mention "conduct" in the title, or contact the maintainer through their GitHub profile.

This code is inspired by the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/).
